mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) relative to historical averages compresses discount rates for equity valuation, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5% (historical threshold).

mechanism_narrative: A rising unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 5.0% signals deteriorating labor market conditions, reducing consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 45% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 5.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate a broad-based demand slowdown, triggering equity sell-offs and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS decline.

mechanism_narrative: High inflation (CPIAUCSL > 3.0% YoY) triggers aggressive monetary tightening by the Federal Reserve, increasing discount rates and reducing equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when CPIAUCSL exceeds 3.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 95.0 (index 2017=100) signals manufacturing contraction, reducing corporate output and profits, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 45% of instances when INDPRO falls below 95.0.

mechanism_narrative: A high level of monthly payroll employment (PAYEMS) above 125,000 thousand persons indicates a strong labor market, supporting consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when PAYEMS exceeds 125,000.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in housing starts (HOUST) below 500.0 thousand units signals weak residential construction, reducing consumer confidence and aggregate demand, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 45% of instances when HOUST falls below 500.0.

mechanism_narrative: A quarterly decline in real GDP (GDPC1) relative to the previous quarter signals economic contraction, reducing corporate earnings growth and leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when GDPC1 declines from the prior quarter.
